products.title: Abbey Road
products.description: The Beatles' eleventh studio album and their final recorded album.
products.fact: The famous crosswalk photo was taken outside Abbey Road Studios in London.

products.title: Kind of Blue
products.description: Regarded as one of the greatest jazz albums of all time.
products.fact: Most of the album was recorded in just two sessions.

products.title: The Dark Side of the Moon
products.description: A concept album exploring themes of conflict, greed, and mental illness.
products.fact: It stayed on the Billboard 200 chart for 14 years.

products.title: Blue Train
products.description: Coltrane's only album as leader for Blue Note Records.
products.fact: The title track became one of Coltrane's most famous compositions.

products.title: Highway 61 Revisited
products.description: Dylan's sixth studio album, featuring 'Like a Rolling Stone'.
products.fact: This album marked Dylan's transition from folk to electric rock.

products.title: Born to Run
products.description: Springsteen's breakthrough album that made him a star.
products.fact: The title track took six months to record and mix.

products.title: Muddy Waters at Newport 1960
products.description: Live recording from the Newport Jazz Festival.
products.fact: This performance helped introduce blues to white audiences.

products.title: Selected Ambient Works 85-92
products.description: Pioneering ambient electronic music album.
products.fact: Many tracks were recorded when Richard D. James was just a teenager.

products.title: Harvest
products.description: Young's most commercially successful album.
products.fact: Features the hit single 'Heart of Gold', Young's only #1 hit.

products.title: Bitches Brew
products.description: Groundbreaking fusion of jazz and rock elements.
products.fact: The album was recorded in just three sessions over three days.

products.title: The Velvet Underground & Nico
products.description: Influential debut album with Andy Warhol's banana cover.
products.fact: The original pressing had a peelable banana sticker on the cover.

products.title: Ambient 1: Music for Airports
products.description: The first album in Eno's ambient series.
products.fact: Designed to be continuously looped as a sound installation.

products.title: Igor
products.description: Tyler has released his sixth studio album, IGOR.
products.fact: The project follows Music Inspired by Illumination & Dr. Seuss’ The Grinch, the 10-minute, six-song EP released last November.

products.title: The Chronic
products.description: elke liedtje is een klassieker en het album heeft een enorme invloed gehad op de hiphopcultuur.
products.fact: Het was zijn eerste soloalbum en wordt beschouwd als een van de beste Rapalbums aller tijden.

products.title: Illmatic
products.description: Illmatic is het debuutalbum van de Amerikaanse Rapper Nas.
products.fact: Illmatic is widely regarded as one of the greatest hip-hop albums of all time.

products.title: To Pimp a Butterfly
products.description: To Pimp a Butterfly is Kendrick Lamar's third studio album.
products.fact: the original title was `Tu Pimp a Caterpillar,` an acronym for `T.U.P.A.C.`, intended as a tribute to Tupac Shakur

products.title: The Miseducation of Lauryn Hill
products.description: a neo soul and R&B album album with some songs based in hip hop, soul and reggae
products.fact: Miseducation Is The First Hip-Hop Record To Win Album Of The Year

products.title: good kid, m.A.A.d city
products.description: Good Kid, M.A.A.D City is het tweede album van de Amerikaanse rapper Kendrick Lamar.
products.fact: the album's title, `m.A.A.d,` is an acronym with two possible meanings: `My Angels on Angel Dust` or `My Angry Adolescence Divided`.

products.title: We Are Not Your Kind
products.description: `We Are Not Your Kind` is the sixth studio album by the American heavy metal band Slipknot
products.fact: We Are Not Your Kind is the only Slipknot album to be recorded as an eight-member band
